newsitem.title: GERMANY: FedEx plans electronic bookings in Europe.
newsitem.headline: FedEx plans electronic bookings in Europe.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said it plans to offer an Internet online cargo reservation service in Europe from early next year.
It said it is testing software for its web site which will allow shippers to complete electronic airway bills and send them to the airline by electronic mail for processing.
FedEx managing director Germany, Antje Schuett, told Reuters in an interview that a Europe home page within the FedEx Internet service had recorded 11,170 "hits" since its September launch.
Several hundred clients had downloaded software on how to complete airway bills" she noted.
The global FedEx Internet service recorded 1.6 million "hits" in September with the shipment tracking facility and tracing function being used up to 13,000 times, Schuett added.
The FedEx home page provides service information, real-time tracking and tracing document preparation, corporate information and general cargo industry information.
